mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `post` ( user_id, category_id, title, content, status, is_pinned, is_hot, like_count, comment_count, favorite_count, view_count, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{isPinned}, #{isHot}, #{likeCount}, #{commentCount}, #{favoriteCount}, #{viewCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 0
SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status != 2 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE category_id = #{categoryId} AND status = 0 ORDER BY is_pinned DESC, create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) > 240 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 240), '...') ELSE p.content END AS content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.is_pinned DESC, p.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE status = 0 AND (create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) OR is_hot = 1) ORDER BY ( COALESCE(like_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(comment_count, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(favorite_count, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(view_count, 0) * 0.5 + CASE WHEN is_hot = 1 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END - TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, NOW()) * 0.8 ) DESC, is_hot DESC, create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM `post` WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT * FROM `post` ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) > 240 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 240), '...') ELSE p.content END AS content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND (p.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) OR p.is_hot = 1) ORDER BY ( COALESCE(p.like_count, 0) * 3 + COALESCE(p.comment_count, 0) * 5 + COALESCE(p.favorite_count, 0) * 2 + COALESCE(p.view_count, 0) * 0.5 + CASE WHEN p.is_hot = 1 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END - TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p.create_time, NOW()) * 0.8 ) DESC, p.is_hot DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) > 240 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 240), '...') ELSE p.content END AS content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(p.content) > 240 THEN CONCAT(SUBSTRING(p.content, 1, 240), '...') ELSE p.content END AS content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p INNER JOIN `user_follow` uf ON uf.followee_id = p.user_id AND uf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 0 ORDER BY p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` p WHERE p.category_id = #{categoryId} AND p.status = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` WHERE status = 0 AND (create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 180 DAY) OR is_hot = 1)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` WHERE status = 0
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` p INNER JOIN `user_follow` uf ON uf.followee_id = p.user_id AND uf.follower_id = #{currentUserId} WHERE p.status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE `post` SET category_id = #{categoryId}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET comment_count = comment_count + 1, last_comment_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET comment_count = GREATEST(comment_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET favorite_count = favorite_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `post` SET favorite_count = GREATEST(favorite_count - 1, 0) WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `post` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 0

SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.category_id, p.title, p.content, p.status, p.is_pinned, p.is_hot, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.favorite_count, p.view_count, p.last_comment_time, p.create_time, p.update_time, u.id as author_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, pc.name as category_name, pc.code as category_code, (SELECT CASE WHEN pi.url LIKE 'data:%' THEN NULL ELSE pi.url END FROM post_image pi WHERE pi.post_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order DESC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) as cover_image FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY p.is_hot DESC, p.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `user` u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id WHERE p.status = 0 AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR pc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
SELECT id FROM `post` WHERE status = 0 ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, update_time FROM `post` WHERE update_time >= #{since} ORDER BY update_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post`
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `post` WHERE status = #{status}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m') AS month, WEEKDAY(create_time) AS weekIndex, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `post` WHERE create_time >= #{startTime} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m'), WEEKDAY(create_time)
SELECT COALESCE(pc.name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM `post` p LEFT JOIN `post_category` pc ON p.category_id = pc.id GROUP BY COALESCE(pc.name, '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC
